name: Youki Marianne
source:
Chris is the boss of the guardsmen. Though he shows loyalty to the king, he has a secret ambition. Yes, he is preparing to kick down the king.... One day, the king suddenly breaks down because of the strain of grief.... Chris soon decides to take action. He shags with Marianne, the princess, and Elise, the queen, and controls the royal family. His ultimate goal is to show Marianne and Elise's indecent behaviors to the king....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
Chris是卫兵队长。尽管表面上忠于国王，他心中却怀有秘密野心。没错，他正准备推翻国王…一天，国王突然因悲痛积郁而病倒…Chris很快决定采取行动。他与公主Marianne和王后Elise发生关系，借此控制王室。他最终的目标，是让国王亲眼看见Marianne与Elise的淫乱行为…
